content.text: The service is up on port 8080. Now I'll run an end-to-end test: login, create a project, trigger a build with a real Maven project ZIP, and verify status, artifact, filesystem side effects, and the log/history endpoints.

input.content:
import base64, io, json, zipfile, requests

BASE = "http://localhost:8080"

def login(u, p):
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/api/auth/login", json={"username": u, "password": p})
    print("login", u, r.status_code, r.json())
    return r.json()["data"]["token"]

tok = login("dev1", "dev123")
H = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {tok}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

# create project
r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/api/projects", headers=H, json={"name": "e2e-proj", "description": "e2e"})
print("create project", r.status_code, r.json())
pid = r.json()["data"]["id"]

# build a maven project zip (pom at root + src)
pom = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
  <groupId>com.example</groupId>
  <artifactId>demo</artifactId>
  <version>1.0</version>
  <packaging>jar</packaging>
  <properties><maven.compiler.source>21</maven.compiler.source><maven.compiler.target>21</maven.compiler.target></properties>
</project>
"""
hello = "package com.example; public class Hello { public static void main(String[] a){ System.out.println(\"hi\"); } }\n"
buf = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w") as z:
    z.writestr("pom.xml", pom)
    z.writestr("src/main/java/com/example/Hello.java", hello)
source_zip = base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()

r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/api/projects/{pid}/builds", headers=H, json={"sourceZip": source_zip}, timeout=180)
print("trigger build", r.status_code)
data = r.json()
print(json.dumps(data, indent=1)[:800])
build = data["data"]
bid = build["id"]
print("STATUS:", build["status"], "ARTIFACT:", build["artifactPath"])
assert build["status"] == "SUCCESS", build["status"]
assert build["artifactPath"] and build["artifactPath"].endswith(".jar")
assert build["finishedAt"] is not None

import os
print("artifact exists on fs:", os.path.exists(build["artifactPath"]))
print("workdir listing:", os.listdir(f"/tmp/builds/{bid}"))
assert os.path.exists(f"/tmp/builds/{bid}/pom.xml")

# history
r = requests.get(f"{BASE}/api/projects/{pid}/builds", headers=H)
hist = r.json()["data"]
print("history:", [(b["id"], b["status"]) for b in hist])
assert hist[0]["id"] == bid

# detail + log
r = requests.get(f"{BASE}/api/builds/{bid}", headers=H)
print("detail status:", r.json()["data"]["status"])
r = requests.get(f"{BASE}/api/builds/{bid}/log", headers=H)
log = r.json()["data"]["log"]
print("log tail:", log[-200:].replace("\n", " | "))
assert "BUILD SUCCESS" in log

# failing build: pom present but compilation error
bad = "package com.example; public class Bad { syntax error here }\n"
buf2 = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(buf2, "w") as z:
    z.writestr("pom.xml", pom)
    z.writestr("src/main/java/com/example/Bad.java", bad)
r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/api/projects/{pid}/builds", headers=H,
                  json={"sourceZip": base64.b64encode(buf2.getvalue()).decode()}, timeout=180)
b2 = r.json()["data"]
print("bad build status:", b2["status"], "artifact:", b2["artifactPath"])
assert b2["status"] == "FAILED" and b2["artifactPath"] is None and b2["finishedAt"]

# no pom -> FAILED
buf3 = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(buf3, "w") as z:
    z.writestr("README.txt", "no pom here")
r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/api/projects/{pid}/builds", headers=H,
                  json={"sourceZip": base64.b64encode(buf3.getvalue()).decode()}, timeout=180)
b3 = r.json()["data"]
print("no-pom build status:", b3["status"], "log:", (b3["logOutput"] or "")[:120])
assert b3["status"] == "FAILED" and b3["logOutput"]

# invalid base64 -> FAILED, no exception escapes
r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/api/projects/{pid}/builds", headers=H, json={"sourceZip": "!!!notbase64!!!"}, timeout=180)
b4 = r.json()["data"]
print("bad-zip build status:", b4["status"], "log:", (b4["logOutput"] or "")[:120])
assert b4["status"] == "FAILED"

# pom in immediate subdirectory
buf5 = io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(buf5, "w") as z:
    z.writestr("sub/pom.xml", pom)
    z.writestr("sub/src/main/java/com/example/Hello.java", hello)
r = requests.post(f"{BASE}/api/projects/{pid}/builds", headers=H,
                  json={"sourceZip": base64.b64encode(buf5.getvalue()).decode()}, timeout=180)
b5 = r.json()["data"]
